items.claim: 管理層重申 2026 年自由現金流每股至少 $8 的機率很高，且有上檔空間
items.quote: at least $8 of free cash flow per share in 2026
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層描述 2025 年整體營收成長為兩位數 13%
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層描述通用型 socket 業務可以取得高毛利
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層說明工廠稼動率落在 80%-90% 是最適區間
items.quote: around 80% to 90% is a sweet spot
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層表示 TI 在中國已經拿到市占率
items.quote: TI has grown share in China.
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層形容中國本土競爭者動作跟客戶一樣快、不能被忽視
items.quote: these competitors are fast moving like their customers
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層宣布收購 Silicon Labs 的計畫
items.quote: announced a plan to acquire Silicon Labs
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層提到自 2021 年起已在 Lehi 廠投資這類混合訊號資產
items.quote: we've invested since 2021 in this mixed-signal asset
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層形容 Silicon Labs 帶來無線連接（IoT）領域的廣泛產品組合
items.quote: nice broad portfolio on the wireless connectivity side
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層強調今年特別要為一系列情境做好準備
items.quote: we are prepared for a range of scenarios
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層指出工業終端市場仍較前波高峰低 25%
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層認為客戶目前並未在囤積庫存
items.quote: customers, I don't think they are building inventory
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層表示若客戶想開始建立庫存，公司願意支持
items.quote: if they want to build some, we want to support them
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層表示預期 Silicon Labs 交易於 2027 上半年完成交割
items.quote: close that transaction in the first half of 2027
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

items.claim: 管理層承諾若市場機會出現，公司在產能與庫存兩方面都會準備好
items.quote: we will be ready, both with capacity
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan

qa_flags.question: How are you feeling about that relative to industry capacity, which seems to maybe be reaching peak utilization rates?
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層先說「不想針對 2026 給出定論（I don't want to call out 2026）」，接著改談稼動率熱點與轉往先進封裝的機會等質性描述，未給出具體 2026 產能利用率或數字

qa_flags.question: But when I said unhappy, the market share has come down.
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層未回應市占率下滑的具體幅度或時間點，改以「這是護城河的一部分」「delayed gratification」等敘事帶過，僅說「開始在過去一年小幅拉升市占率」但未給出數字
